title: What Does the Lion Say? Roar Along with Milo!
description:
What does the lion say? Roar, roar, roar! A 13-second animal sounds sing-along for kids with Milo the bluebird and the lion.
Learn animal sounds, then roar along. From the Animal Sounds Song on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: What Do Giraffes Eat? Munch Along with Milo!
description:
What do giraffes eat? Acacia leaves, way up high! A short animal song for kids: the giraffe grabs leaves with her long tongue.
Learn what zoo animals eat and stretch up tall. From "What Do Animals Eat?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: What Do Elephants Eat? Toot Along with Milo!
description:
What do elephants eat? Grass, leaves, bark and fruit! A short animal song for kids: the elephant picks up lunch with its trunk.
Learn what zoo animals eat and toot along. From "What Do Animals Eat?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Where Is My Mama? Baby Animals Sing-Along with Milo!
description:
Where is my mama? Milo helps the baby animals find their mamas in this short sing-along for kids.
Baby animals song with a lion cub, a baby elephant and a baby giraffe. From "Where Is My Mama?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Baby Elephant Finds Mama! Toot Toot with Milo!
description:
Where is baby elephant's mama? Toot, toot! Listen for the trunk and find her with Milo the bluebird.
A short baby animals song for kids about elephants. From "Where Is My Mama?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Milo Had a Zoo, E-I-E-I-O! And a Lion Says Roar!
description:
Milo had a zoo, E-I-E-I-O! And at the zoo he had a lion: roar here, roar there!
A short animal sounds sing-along for kids to the Old MacDonald tune. From "Milo Had a Zoo!" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Where Is Baby Giraffe's Mama? Look Up High!
description:
Where is baby giraffe's mama? She is very tall, so look up high with Milo the bluebird!
A short baby animals song for kids about giraffes. From "Where Is My Mama?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Count 1, 2, 3 Zoo Animals! Counting Song with Milo
description:
One big lion, two little monkeys, three tall giraffes! Count 1, 2, 3 with Milo the bluebird.
A short counting song for kids with zoo animals. From "Can You Count 10 Zoo Animals?" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-5.

Be kind to every animal.

title: Shake Like a Lion, Flap Like an Elephant! Action Song
description:
Shake your head like a lion and flap your ears like an elephant! A short action song for kids with Milo.
Move along to "Head, Shoulders, Knees and Paws!" on The Animated Zoo. Ages 2-6.

Be kind to every animal.
